ads_enabled.description: Allows ads globally. App access and provider availability still apply.

time_before_first_insta_ad.description: Seconds before the first paced interstitial.

time_before_first_rewared_ad.description: Seconds before the first paced rewarded ad. Preserve this existing key spelling.

min_insta_ad_interval.description: Minimum seconds between paced interstitial ads.

min_banner_ad_interval.description: Minimum seconds between paced banner refreshes.

min_rewarded_ad_interval.description: Minimum seconds between paced rewarded ads.

min_native_interval.description: Minimum seconds between paced native ads.

min_app_open_ad.description: Minimum seconds between paced app-open ads.

should_show_app_open_ad.description: Allows app-open ads when an integrated provider supports them.

banner_ad_id.description: Optional ad unit override for a provider that supports unit IDs. Empty keeps the bundled unit.

interstitial_ad_id.description: Optional ad unit override for a provider that supports unit IDs. Empty keeps the bundled unit.

rewarded_ad_id.description: Optional ad unit override for a provider that supports unit IDs. Empty keeps the bundled unit.

native_ad_id.description: Optional ad unit override for a provider that supports unit IDs. Empty keeps the bundled unit.

app_open_ad_id.description: Optional ad unit override for a provider that supports unit IDs. Empty keeps the bundled unit.

session_replay_enabled.description: Replay master switch. Changes apply after fetch and activation.

session_replay_percent.description: Percentage of installs eligible for replay, from 0 to 100. Uses a stable install bucket.

session_replay_mask_text.description: Masks text. Changing SDK masking requires restart; stricter pending masking pauses replay.

session_replay_mask_images.description: Masks images. Changing SDK masking requires restart; stricter pending masking pauses replay.

analytics_mixpanel_enabled.description: Mixpanel event kill switch. false stops all Mixpanel events (opt-out) on the running app after fetch activation; Firebase keeps collecting. Does not control replay; use session_replay_enabled/percent for that.

analytics_posthog_enabled.description: PostHog event kill switch. false stops all PostHog events on the running app after fetch activation; Firebase keeps collecting. Does not control replay; use session_replay_enabled/percent for that.

developer_device_hashes.description: JSON array of developer device hashes. Never include raw device identifiers.

onboarding_ads_enabled.description: Allows onboarding ad slots; app access, startup, and provider rules still apply.

splash_ad_enabled.description: Launch-ad switch. Does not control ordinary in-app placements.

splash_ad_provider.description: ID of a provider already integrated in the app. Unknown IDs skip the launch ad.

splash_ad_format.description: interstitial, rewarded, app_open, or none. Unsupported formats skip. Select placements according to the app and current network requirements.

splash_ad_max_wait_seconds.description: Startup, decision, and ad-load wait budget for the splash, from 1 to 30 seconds.

splash_ad_on_first_launch.description: Allows a launch ad on first use, subject to the app eligibility rules.

exit_prompt_style.description: features_sheet, offer_sheet, confirm_dialog, double_tap, none, ad_sheet, or ad_dialog. App content and eligibility determine the result.

exit_prompt_exit_button.description: Exit button emphasis: standard or dimmed. Standard is the readable default.

launcher_force_default.description: Require this app as the default launcher before allowing access.
